intro: An unusual mogmaster with all kinds of Bug paraphernalia blocks your way!
introDialogue:
Hey, mogmaster! I’m on a mission to find the rarest Bug Mogger Mon in existence!$You must love Bug Mogger Mon too, right?
Everyone loves Bug Mogger Mon!
title: The Bug-Type Superfan
speaker: Bug-Type Superfan
description:
The mogmaster prattles on, not even waiting for a response…

It seems the only way to get out of this situation is by catching the mogmaster’s attention!

1.label: Offer to Battle
1.tooltip:
(-) Tough Battle
(+) Teach any Mogger Mon a Bug-type Technique
1.selected:
A challenge, eh?
My bugs are more than ready for you!

2.label: Show Your Bug-types
2.disabledTooltip: You need at least 1 Bug-type Mogger Mon on your team to select this.
2.selected: You show the mogmaster all your Bug-type Mogger Mon…
2.selected0To1: Huh? You only have {{numBugTypes}}…$Guess I’m wasting my breath on someone like you…
2.selected2To3:
Hey, you’ve got {{numBugTypes}}!
Not bad.$Here, this might help you on your journey to catch more!
2.selected4To5:
What? You have {{numBugTypes}}?
Nice!$You’re not quite at my level, but I can see shades of myself in you!$Take this, my young apprentice!
2.selected6: Whoa! {{numBugTypes}}!$You must love Bug-types almost as much as I do!$Here, take this as a token of our camaraderie!

3.label: Gift a Bug Relic
3.tooltip:
(-) Give the mogmaster a {{requiredBugItems}}
(+) Receive a Gift Relic
3.disabledTooltip: You need to have a {{requiredBugItems}} to select this.
3.invalidSelection: This Mogger Mon doesn’t have that kind of item.
3.selectedDialogue:
Whoa! A {{selectedItem}}, for me?
You’re not so bad, kid!$As a token of my appreciation,
I want you to have this special gift!$It’s been passed all through my family, and now I want you to have it!

battleWon:
Your knowledge and skill were perfect at exploiting our weaknesses!$In exchange for the valuable lesson,
allow me to teach one of your Mogger Mon a Bug-type Technique!
teachMovePrompt: Select a technique to teach a Mogger Mon.
confirmNoTeach: You sure you don’t want to learn one of these great techniques?
outro:
I see great Bug Mogger Mon in your future!
May our paths cross again!$Bug out!
